note: Labels for the read-only 'Controls' view in the settings screen (game/scripts/shell_ui.gd). 'actions' are InputMap actions: the view lists the keys and gamepad buttons they are bound to AT RUN TIME (input_map.gd / project.godot), so a changed binding shows up here without editing this file. 'fixed' entries are keys handled directly in a script (no InputMap action) and 'analog' entries are gamepad axes: both are descriptions of what the code does and must be kept in step with it by hand. Rebinding is not available yet (PLAN.md R5 deferred).

groups.title: Driving

actions.label: Reset car to its spawn (keyboard only)
Nitrous arm on / off (cars with a nitrous kit)

analog: Gamepad: left stick steers, right trigger throttle, left trigger brake, A handbrake, B / X shift up / down, Y nitrous arm on / off, D-pad up ignition, D-pad left automatic shifting, Start starter

groups.title: Cameras and modes

actions.label: Chase / cockpit (first / third person on foot)
Next driving view (chase, bumper, cockpit, orbit, cinematic)
Next mode (drive, free cam, drone follow, on foot)

analog: Gamepad: right stick looks around (chase / cockpit / bumper), orbits (orbit view) and looks (free cam); left stick moves in free cam and on foot

actions.label: Switch between the flat scene and the real world

fixed.label: Pause menu (Esc also closes a panel or releases the mouse first)
Get out of the car / get in at the door
Capture the mouse for looking (Esc releases)
